I priced our first joggers at ₹699. Felt fair. Six weeks later I found out we were losing ₹38 on every order.

Here's what I'd missed. Amazon's fees aren't one number. There's the referral fee, the closing fee, shipping, and returns, and returns were eating us alive.

So I put it all in a sheet. Took an evening. The price that actually broke even was ₹849.

We're at ₹999 now and making about ₹190 an order. Do the sheet before you set a price, not after.
